_about: Dota item actives and passives in the engine's effect tree (docs/DOTA_PACK.md). Same format and rules as abilities.json: values are references to the item's dotaconstants keys ("$key"); "passive" is one modifier template merged into the item's stat bonuses, "active" is an ability (id item_<item>). status: full or simplified (with a note).

basher.note: the melee chance for every hero (ranged heroes have the ranged chance in Dota)

black_king_bar.note: basic dispel, debuff immunity and the magic resistance: no immunity to pure and reflected damage

abyssal_blade.note: Bash: the melee chance for every hero, no unique-bash rule; Overwhelm does not pierce debuff immunity; slow resistance and health restoration amplification not modelled

ancient_janggo.note: Endurance has no limit of 8 item charges

bloodthorn.note: Pierce: the chance of bonus magical damage without piercing evasion; Soul Rend: silence only (no damage at the end of the silence, no bonus attack damage, no true strike on the target)

buckler.note: the aura armor goes to allied heroes only (Dota: all player-controlled units, summons included)

crellas_crozier.note: Putrefaction Aura not modelled (no health restoration reduction); Rite of Rumusque: ghost form (physical immunity, disarm, magic resistance loss) with a non-stacking slow aura on enemy heroes instead of the stolen movement speed, no health redirection, does not end on debuff immunity

dagon_2.note: the cast range bonus for other spells is not modelled

desolator.note: Corruption only: no Soul Stealer damage growth; stacks with Orb of Blight

disperser.note: Manabreak deals its full physical damage even when the target has less mana than the burn; Suppress active not mapped (slow and haste decaying from 100% to 0% over the duration)

ghost.note: the ghost form does not end on debuff immunity

gungir.note: the bonus AoE for other spells not modelled

invis_sword.note: no fade time, no free pathing through units; the bonus damage of the next attack stays after the invisibility is broken by a cast

lesser_crit.note: the critical strike is the crit_chance and crit_multiplier stat bonuses

mage_slayer.note: the damage over time only: no outgoing spell damage reduction

mask_of_madness.note: the ranged movement speed bonus for every hero (melee 12%), no slow resistance

monkey_king_bar.note: the chance of bonus magical damage without piercing evasion; the melee attack range bonus not modelled

orchid.note: silence only: no damage at the end of the silence

radiance.note: Burn is always on (no toggle); illusions burn like the hero

silver_edge.note: no fade time, no free pathing through units; the breaking attack deals its bonus damage but does not break passives or cap movement speed; the bonus stays after the invisibility is broken by a cast

specialists_array.note: also for melee bearers; the extra hits go to the nearest enemies without the 120 degree cone, carry on-hit effects, and neither they nor the primary attack get the flat 20 damage

vladmir.note: the bonus damage is a percent of the whole attack damage (Dota: base damage); full lifesteal against creeps (Dota: 12%)

assault.note: the allied aura only (attack speed and armor); no enemy armor reduction aura (one aura per modifier); structures only if the engine's aura reaches them

blink.note: no 3 s lockout after taking hero damage; no clamp to the shorter range when cast beyond the maximum

boots_of_bearing.note: Endurance without the 1.5 s slow immunity

butterfly.note: evasion stacks the engine's way, not diminishingly; the 20% attack speed bonus (bonus_attack_speed_pct) has no percent attack speed field

dagon_3.note: does not kill illusions instantly; the cast range bonus for other spells is not modelled

devastator.note: Witch Blade's poison lands at once (0.75 x intelligence per second x 4 s) with the slow; Magic Corruption rides on the same 4 s proc (lasting 4 s it stays up while attacking) instead of every attack; no true strike

ethereal_blade.note: enemies only (no ally cast); the extra magic damage taken as a magic resistance reduction; the stat damage as three hits (strength, agility, intelligence) plus the base

glimmer_cape.note: no 0.5 s fade delay; the barrier absorbs all damage, not only magic

heavens_halberd.note: the disarm is removed by any dispel (Dota: strong dispels only)

hurricane_pike.note: enemy cast only: the target is pushed away (the caster is not pushed back, so half the separation); the 5 fast attacks are not tied to the target and keep the normal attack range; no self/ally push

javelin.note: the proc does not pierce evasion

mekansm.note: no Restore lockout for units healed within the cooldown; several auras stack

orb_of_corrosion.note: the melee-target slow against every target (ranged targets are slowed twice as much in Dota); no health restoration reduction

overwhelming_blink.note: the damage over time lands at once with the instant part; no 3 s lockout after taking hero damage; no range clamp

pipe.note: the barrier absorbs all damage, not only magic; no Barrier lockout within the cooldown; several auras stack

rod_of_atos.note: the root lands at once (no projectile speed in the data)

shadow_amulet.note: invisible at once (no 1.25 s fade time)

skadi.note: the melee bearer's move slow for every bearer (ranged bearers slow twice as much in Dota); no health restoration reduction

tranquil_boots.note: the break removes the bonus health regeneration only; the move speed bonus stays (the drop to 40 needs the difference of two keys)

lifesteal.note: the lifesteal is the item stat lifesteal_percent (already a bonus); entry marks the passive as covered

arcane_blink.note: blink to the point with the heal and mana restore; no lock after taking hero damage, no self-cast toward the fountain

bfury.note: Cleave only: a circle of the cleave distance around the target instead of a cone, the hero percent also against creeps, ranged heroes cleave too; no Quell (bonus damage against non-heroes), no Chop Tree (no trees)

cyclone.note: enemy targets only (no self-cast); the cyclone is a stun with physical and debuff immunity (magical damage still lands, no full invulnerability); the landing damage is dealt at the cast

diffusal_blade.note: Manabreak only (1 damage per burnt mana written as 100 percent: $damage_per_burn*100 is a unit conversion); no Inhibit active (the data has no slow value); illusions burn mana too

echo_sabre.note: the second attack lands at once with the first; ranged heroes echo too (melee only in Dota)

force_staff.note: self-cast only: the caster dashes up to the push length toward a chosen point (Dota pushes in the facing direction); no use on allies or enemies

greater_crit.note: Critical Strike from the item's crit stats (crit_chance, crit_multiplier); it also crits buildings (not in Dota)

harpoon.note: Draw Forth pulls the enemy all the way to the caster (Dota moves both: to melee range for melee, 35% of the distance for ranged), no tree target; Echo Strike's second attack lands at once, ranged heroes echo too

hydras_breath.note: Polycephaly hits the nearest enemies around the attacker (no 120-degree cone) without the +20 flat damage, for melee heroes too; extra hits carry all on-hit effects (Dota: only Miasma)

meteor_hammer.note: always channelled fully (the channel time as the cast point), lands at once (no landing delay); units only (no building damage)

orb_of_frost.note: the -13% slow on every attack (Dota: -6% in the melee case); no health restoration reduction

pavise.note: the barrier absorbs damage of any type (physical only in Dota)

sheepstick.note: disarm and silence: no fixed 140 movement speed, no mute (items still usable), passives kept

solar_crest.note: the barrier absorbs damage of any type (physical only in Dota); a self-cast also gives the armor, attack and movement speed

wind_waker.note: the cyclone is a stun with physical and debuff immunity (magical damage still lands, no full invulnerability); no landing damage on enemies (one effect list for all teams); the self tornado cannot be moved

blade_mail.note: only the flat part of the passive return (physical damage to each attacker); no 15% of the attack's damage returned and no active Damage Return (no reflection in the engine)

diffusal_blade_2.note: Manabreak only (no reduced burn for illusions); no active Purge: the data has no slow value (decaying slow)

guardian_greaves.note: no Mend lockout for units healed by Mend or Mekansm within the cooldown; the aura lacks the higher health regeneration below the health threshold

maelstrom.note: the lightning hits every enemy within the chain radius of the attacked unit at once instead of bouncing to 4 targets; procs only on landed attacks

manta.note: the melee images' damage for every hero (ranged images deal 25% in Dota); no brief invulnerability; the images do not copy items or passives

mjollnir.note: Chain Lightning hits every enemy within the chain radius of the attacked unit at once instead of bouncing to 12 targets; Static Charge only on the bearer (the data has no cast range) and hits every enemy within the static radius instead of the attacker and 4 others

phase_boots.note: the melee speed bonus for every hero (ranged heroes get less in Dota); no moving through units or faster turning

revenants_brooch.note: the bonus magic damage is a share of the average attack damage; it also procs against buildings; no spell lifesteal

shivas_guard.note: Arctic Blast lands at once on every enemy in the blast radius instead of an expanding wave following the caster; several Freezing Auras stack; no AoE bonus

swift_blink.note: no lockout after taking damage from heroes; no range clamp for casts beyond the range; the speed bonus is not phased

witch_blade.note: the poison's whole damage (0.75 x intelligence per second for the duration) lands with the hit; no True Strike

dagon.note: does not kill illusions instantly; the cast range bonus for other spells is not modelled

dagon_4.note: does not kill illusions instantly; the cast range bonus for other spells is not modelled

dagon_5.note: does not kill illusions instantly; the cast range bonus for other spells is not modelled
